service.description: When the UTC hour of nowStamp is errors.digest.hourUtc and today's email is not claimed yet: claims the day, reads run errors, the watchdog and the log rows across every tenant (read-only), emails the digest to errors.email.to (every day, "none" included) and posts a one-line summary to errors.chat.webhookUrl. darpan.ops.ErrorDigestSupport.sendIfDue.

parameter.name: nowStamp
parameter.description: The moment to judge "due" at; pinned by tests, now otherwise.

parameter.name: outcome
parameter.description: sent, reason (null, NOT_THE_HOUR, ALREADY_SENT, NO_DESTINATION, DELIVERY_FAILED), subject and warnings when it ran.

service.description: Stores the ERROR log lines captured in memory since the last flush (darpan.ops.ErrorLogCapture.flush, its own transaction, never throws), then deletes the stored rows more than 30 days old.

parameter.name: purged
parameter.description: Rows deleted as more than 30 days old.
